<trace_source block_id="synthetic-1" lang="c">struct Node { int value; struct Node *next; };
struct Node *reverse(struct Node *head) {
  struct Node *prev = NULL, *current = head;
  while (current) {
    struct Node *next = current->next;
    current->next = prev;
    prev = current;
    current = next;
  }
  return prev;
}</trace_source>
